content: Devid ọmaana Batshẹba

M'ope-yaabhagbe, k'ogbe kw'avaar am-atza egbong, wa Devid ọtzọhm Joab ọmaana akhaan-nọng p'ọvaarnọng ttara anọng p'Israẹl biphyir egbong. Bẹ atza afhu anọng p'Ammọn, abira akhọri obhon kwa Raba akhe k'ottem. Yina, wa Devid owobha ka Jẹrusalẹm.
K'ẹchọhkhawu dani, Devid obina k'ebin ọtza orenga ọkhọri ebir-ebir kw'ẹvaar-ttọhmma. Owobha kẹ ore kwanọng wani kw'om-ogbobha asi. Wa kwanọng nwuma ojibh-ojibh.
Wa Devid ọtzọhm ọnọng bi, otza oronga ọnọng kwa kwanọng nwa ode. Ojinọng nwuma ọgbaak Devid bi, “Batshẹba kw'ode nnwa kw'ikwanọng kw'Eliyam, obiro ode kwanọng kw'Uriya kw'ofon Het wọ e.”
Mẹ wọ, Devid ọtzọhm akkaabh-nkkaabha pẹ atza atzim-ẹ akwu. Okwu opyiri, oyim-ẹ abẹ. Yina kw'iwa kwanọng nwa ọrami ọmmaana-dik kw'awurada pa for ottotto okyera mẹ. Iwa ọkpa nnam ọbhana.
Iwa kwanọng nwa otzima ibhọr, ọtzọhm ẹkkaabha ọnang Devid, oben bi, “Kaam nkk'ibhọr ndima e.”
Mẹ wọ, Devid ọtzọhm ẹkkaabha ọnang Joab oben bi, “Tzọhm Uriya kw'ofon Het chen-m.” Wa Joab ọtzọhm-ẹ ochena Devid.
Mada Uriya okhebh-ẹ, Devid ọbọbh-ẹ odem kwa Joab owobh, ọmaana odem kw'agbong-nọng awobh ttara eden ch'egbong ede.
Mẹ wọ, Devid oben Uriya bi, “Rọhng atza agbobhi mmo k'ọhọhm kwọ.” Uriya otte ẹvaar-ttọhmma ọbọhk ofona, ọvaarnọng obiro ọtzọhm ẹnanga ochen-ẹ.
Yina, iwa Uriya okponga mẹ ẹbaakhamma ch'ẹvaar-ttọhmma oyima ttara atzọhmnọng p'itta kwẹ, k'ọhọhm kwẹ kọtza.
Mada bẹ agbaakhi Devid bi, “Uriya k'ọhọhm kwẹ k'ọbhan e,” Devid ọbọbh-ẹ bi, “Yina rang kw'afon k'oden-mir akwu ma o? Ode yan kw'ani k'ọhọhm kwọ abhan?”

Uriya oben Devid bi, “Ẹkkọhbhi ch'Echekhi ọmaana anọng p'Israẹl ttara pa Juda ayim k'okhira, Joab kw'ode oho kwaam ọmaana atzọhmnọng p'itta kwaam, abhingi k'ọyaankpa. Okhuri yan kwa kaam nna mmana k'ọhọhm kwaam bi, nda nchi mbiri ngwo mbiri nyima ttara kwanọng kwaam o? Odem nwa kwa kọ arukhi akpen, kaam odik-dema nwa kinsi!”
Mẹ wọ e, Devid on-oben-ẹ bi, “Kọ biri wobha ma mayina, ophyini kaam ńdọhm-ọ akpa nnam.” Wa Uriya owobha ma Jẹrusalẹm m'ewu nduma ọmaana ewu ch'ehobh mẹ.

Devid oyer-ẹ okwu ochi ọchattọhk obiro agwo atzuk ttar-ẹ. Iwa Devid ọnang-ẹ atzuk maa obuma. Yina, m'ẹchọhkha, Uriya oyin k'iyaan otza oyima k'obhirikpa kwẹ, k'ottem kw'atzọhmnọng p'itta kwẹ; k'ọhọhm kwẹ kọbhan.
K'ekpebha, Devid ọkkẹr ẹkkaabha k'ẹnwẹrkpa ọnang Uriya bi, ochena Joab.
Ọkkẹri m'ẹnwẹrkpa nduma bi, “Hok Uriya k'itzitzikha s'egbong, kw'erima ẹkhọhm-ọkhọhm. Atzọr akpa nnam ifha bẹ abun-ẹ afhu, ope.”
Mẹ wọ, mada Joab okk'odedenmon ọkhọri okhe k'ottem, ọtzọkha Uriya ohok k'ibe s'orong bi akkakkaama p'attattaanga-nọng pabẹ awobh.
Mada ajinọng p'odedenmon nwuma ayini k'iyaan bi, bẹ akwu arima Joab abẹ, wa bẹ afhu agbong-nọng bani pa Devid. Ayongi mẹ, wa Uriya kw'ofon Het obiro ope.
Iwa Joab ọtzọhm Devid ẹkkaabha ch'odik kpenamkpen kw'otto k'egbong-dam.
Oben ọkkaabh-ẹkkaabha bi, “Idikha akk'ọvaarnọng odem kw'egbong ede agbaakha okpo,
ọvaarnọng ọfha ọdọkh-ẹ, ọbọbh-ọ bi, ‘Okhuri yan kwa bọng atza arima egbong abaanga k'odedenmon o? Ode bi bọng karong bi, bẹ afha awobha k'echumiho atta ayukh o?

Anyi wọ ofhu Abimẹlẹk kw'ode nnwa kw'ijinọng kwa Jerub-Bẹshẹt? Kwanọng arang owobh k'echumiho obingi ẹtzakpa ch'ẹfhẹ-ẹ ka Tẹbẹz o? Okhuri yan kwa bọng areng abaanga k'echum o?’ Idikha ọbọbh-ọ idik nna, kọ gbaakh-ẹ bi, ‘Ayongi mẹ, ọtzọhmnọng kwọ Uriya kw'ofon Het obiro ope e.’ ”
Mẹ wọ e, ọkkaabh-ẹkkaabha nwuma obina ofona, mada opyiri, ọtzọkha odik kpenamkpen kwa Joab ọkk'ẹ ọtzọhma, ọgbaak Devid.
Ọkkaabh-ẹkkaabha nwuma oben Devid bi, “Ajinọng mbuma ayọhng man mkpaan, bẹ ayini k'iyaan akwu arima man abẹ k'ọyaankpa. Yina, mokhubhi bẹ maa bẹ akpa nnam k'ẹbaakhamma ch'odedenmon.
Mẹ wọ kw'atta-ayuk awobh k'echumiho atta atzọhmnọng pọ ayuk, ofona mẹ, atzọhmnọng bani p'ọvaarnọng ape. Ayongi mẹ, ọtzọhmnọng kwọ Uriya kw'ofon Het ọkk'ọpa.”

Devid e, oben ọkkaabh-ẹkkaabha nwa bi, “Ben Joab bi, ‘Odik nwa oning-ọ ottem-pyibha ọnangi; ọkkangkkaang kw'ofhu ọnọng, óbiro ofhu ọnọng ọdọdọk. Tte ochina ororo orima odedenmon nwa abẹ obiro odim-ẹ.’ Kọ gbaak odik nwa atzim akhe Joab ẹfa.”
Mada kwanọng kw'Uriya ọbhaang bi odim kwẹ ọkk'ọpa, owobha epopa ch'odim.
Mada ogbe kw'epopa ottong, Devid e, ọtza ọtzọkh-ẹ otzima ochina k'ọhọhm kwẹ, on-ode kwanọng kwẹ, ọmaan-ẹ nnwa kw'ijinọng. Yina, odik nwuma kwa Devid ọkk'ọsa, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ettem kọdaami.
